body.description: SRT or RTMP URL of the destination endpoint where the stream will be republished. Encode the URL if required

status.description: Status of the RTMP muxer, possible values are started, finished, failed, broadcasting, {@link IAntMediaStreamHandler#BROADCAST_STATUS_*}

type.description: The service name like facebook, periscope, youtube or generic

endpointUrl.description: RTMP or SRT URL of the endpoint

endpointServiceId.description: The endpoint service id, this field holds the id of the endpoint

schema.description: The endpoint class, such as Facebook, Twitter or custom RTMP endpoints
schema.title: Endpoint
